topics.title: The Staff: Lines and Spaces
topics.short: Five lines and four spaces: where notes sit, how to count them, and how higher on the page means higher in sound.

topics.title: The Treble Clef
topics.short: The G clef and the notes on its lines and spaces, with memory aids, landmark notes and drills from the staff to the keys and back.

topics.title: The Bass Clef
topics.short: The F clef for low notes: its lines and spaces, memory aids, landmark notes, and drills from the staff to the keys and back.

topics.title: The Grand Staff, Middle C and Ledger Lines
topics.short: How piano music joins the treble and bass staves, where middle C lives between them, and how ledger lines carry notes above and below.

topics.title: Note Values and Rests
topics.short: Whole, half, quarter, eighth and sixteenth notes, the rests that match them, dots, ties and triplets: how long each note lasts, counted in beats.

topics.title: Beats, Measures and Time Signatures
topics.short: Bar lines divide music into measures; the time signature says how many beats each one holds. Count “1 & 2 &” and tap rhythms with the click.

topics.title: Sharps, Flats and Naturals
topics.short: The signs that raise, lower and restore a note, where they go on the staff, and how long they last.

topics.title: Key Signatures
topics.short: The sharps or flats at the start of every line: what they mean, the order they always come in, and how to name the key from them.

topics.title: Scales and the Circle of Fifths
topics.short: The major scale’s pattern of whole and half steps, why each key needs its sharps or flats, the natural minor scale, and the circle of fifths that ties every key together.

topics.title: Intervals and Chords
topics.short: Measure the distance between two notes by counting letters, tell major from minor and perfect, and build the three-note chords called triads.

topics.title: Dynamics, Tempo and Articulation
topics.short: How loud (p, mf, f, crescendo), how fast (Andante, Allegro, rit.), and how each note is played (legato, staccato, accents, fermatas).

topics.title: Repeats and Endings
topics.short: Repeat signs, first and second endings, D.C., D.S., Fine and Coda: the road signs that tell you where to go next.
